note: Before/after comparison between the production build of main@b5ce532 and the production build of this branch, taken on one machine in one sitting. This file records the results, not the tooling that produced them.

captures.mainVersusBranch: 0 of 15 capture pairs differ: byte-identical PNGs in all three engines, including the enlarged-text scenarios
captures.enlargedText: verified to engage the container-query layout rather than duplicating the default case: .workflow-node computes to position: relative at 200% root text and absolute at default size

againstCommittedPreviews.webkit: 1.23% of pixels at 1440px and 2.02% at 390px, in the same regions for main and for this branch: engine drift against the September captures, unchanged by this refactor
againstCommittedPreviews.chrome: not compared: those captures use an installed Google Chrome, which this check does not run

geometry.method: whole-document snapshot of 52 computed properties and the bounding box of every element, aligned by tag, class and ordinal
expectedDifferences: 15 × div.hero-illustration added: the element the illustration is mounted into
45 × svg.ribbon-motif keys moved: the class attribute no longer carries a trailing space
3 × div.workflow max-width relocated to the wrapper element; the rendered box is unchanged

dom.method: element map aligned by tag, class and ordinal, comparing every attribute, plus body text
differences: div.hero-illustration added: the element the illustration is mounted into
the four workflow nodes moved their inline offsets from left/top to --node-x/--node-y
the workflow ribbon svg gained xmlns and stroke-width attributes
the service ribbons' class attribute no longer carries a trailing space

animation.drawDuration: measured during a transition: stroke-dasharray progresses 0.14 → 0.55 → 0.95 at 620ms and reaches complete by 900ms, so the 600ms node transition does not cut the 750ms draw short (a version that settled on node completion measured complete at 620ms)
animation.restingState: a completed choice rests in the same still composition as a fresh page; tests/workflow.spec.ts asserts this and fails without the completion cleanup

artwork.attributeChange: the class attribute was dropped from the standalone files; no stylesheet can reach it there

regression.test: tests/workflow.spec.ts, interrupted illustration compared with a fresh motionless rendering
regression.mutation: removing the reduced-motion settle fails the test on all three engines

not_verified: physical iOS/Android devices and branded browsers
